service_id.description: Plural service ID used to authorize log access and scope results to that service. Provide this or cluster_id.

cluster_id.description: Plural cluster ID used to authorize log access and scope results to that cluster. Provide this or service_id.

query.description: Query string used to select logs to aggregate.

bucket_size.description: The duration of each aggregation bucket, for example 5m.

facets.description: Facet filters used to narrow the aggregated logs.

operator.description: How query tokens and facets are combined.

start.description: The start time in ISO8601 format.

end.description: The end time in ISO8601 format.
